'''Anbav'k''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] equipment master of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], during which they were aboard the Republic's [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Enclave Equipment Master Anbav'k was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.2, as a Nightmare Force Vendor for Operation: Terror From Beyond,<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2.2/operation-nightmare|text=Game Update 2.2: Operation Nightmare Patch Notes}}</ref> though Anbav'k was later removed in a reorganizing of endgame gear.<ref name="TOR" />
